component.name: catalog-risk-auditor
component.description: Audits a music catalog for AI-generated recordings before acquisition and reports the exposure as a recommended escrow.

properties.name: note
properties.value: The runtime dependency tree is empty: this software imports only the Python standard library. CI asserts the absence of requirements.txt, pyproject.toml, setup.py, Pipfile and poetry.lock on every push, and imports the package without running pip install.
